name: The Black-Hull Crew
goal: Move the contraband out of the cove and silence anyone who can tie the sloop to the Teal Moon

clocks.name: Empty the smugglers' cave
clocks.consequence: The crew hauls the last contraband crates from the smugglers-cave onto the black-hulled sloop — the evidence is nearly gone.

clocks.name: Prepare retaliation
clocks.consequence: The black-hulled sloop lands a raiding party outside the village, hunting whoever opened the crate.

name: The Cove Villagers
goal: Keep the village out of a fight it cannot win, whatever the truth costs

clocks.name: Word of the crate spreads
clocks.consequence: Frightened villagers gather at the harbor-dock demanding Brenna throw the crate back into the sea, proof and all.
